name: Yet Another Killing Game
source:
You wake up in a house, alone with two beautiful girls... But no one is allowed to leave until one of you DIES. Why is this happening? What is the purpose of this “killing game”? But most importantly...WHO SHOULD DIE?

[From [url=https://junkakeru.itch.io/yet-another-killing-game]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一所房子里醒来，独自一人和两个美丽的女孩……但任何人都不允许离开，直到你们中的一个死去。为什么会发生这种情况？这场“杀人游戏”的目的是什么？但最重要的是……谁应该死？

[来自[url=https://junkakeru.itch.io/yet-another-killing-game]itch.io[/url]]
